messages.text:
The generated verifier is green, but the original-test audit command itself failed from PowerShell pipeline syntax, not from the port.

I’m rerunning that audit with the environment set correctly, because the completion standard requires real evidence from applicable original cases as well as generated oracle comparisons.

commands.commandLine:
$env:PYTHONIOENCODING='utf-8'
@'
import tomllib, shlex, subprocess, os, sys
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd(); ref=Path((root/'REFERENCE_BINARY.txt').read_text().strip()); port=root/'executable'
patterns=['rust-reference/tests/cmd/*_all.toml','rust-reference/tests/cmd/*_windows.toml','rust-reference/tests/cmd/*_unix.toml','rust-reference/tests/ptests/*.toml']
files=[]
for pat in patterns: files += sorted(root.glob(pat))
sel=[]
for f in files:
    data=tomllib.loads(f.read_text())
    args=data.get('args','')
    excluded=['--color always','--colour always','--icons always','--icons=always','--absolute','--hyperlink','--git','--extended','--blocksize','--header','--time-style relative','--octal','--inode','--links','--group','--numeric','--flags','--context']
    if any(x in args for x in excluded):
        continue
    if any(x in args for x in ['tests/itest','tests/test_dir']):
        if any(y in args for y in ['--long','-l','--tree','-T','--all','--almost-all','--sort','--group-directories','--color never','--colour never','--icons never','--binary','--bytes','--classify','--no-user','--no-time','--no-filesize']) or f.parent.name=='cmd':
            sel.append((f,args))
print('selected',len(sel))
fail=[]
env=os.environ.copy(); env.update({'NO_COLOR':'1','CLICOLOR':'0','PYTHONIOENCODING':'utf-8'})
for f,args in sel:
    argv=shlex.split(args, posix=False)
    r=subprocess.run([str(ref)]+argv,cwd=root/'rust-reference',stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,env=env,timeout=10)
    p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,str(port)]+argv,cwd=root/'rust-reference',stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,env=env,timeout=10)
    if (r.returncode,r.stdout,r.stderr)!=(p.returncode,p.stdout,p.stderr):
        fail.append((f,args,r,p))
        if len(fail)>=12: break
print('fail',len(fail))
for f,args,r,p in fail:
    print('CASE',f.relative_to(root).as_posix(),args)
    print('REF',r.returncode, repr(r.stdout.decode('utf-8','replace')[:600]), repr(r.stderr.decode('utf-8','replace')[:300]))
    print('PORT',p.returncode, repr(p.stdout.decode('utf-8','replace')[:600]), repr(p.stderr.decode('utf-8','replace')[:300]))
'@ | python -
